text:
zoe-ps: Heads up: GreenGrocer POC saw repeated 5xxs during live demo at 09:07. They were doing multiple streaming chats (7 conc, ~4.5k context) and got timeouts. Can SRE triage fast?

nina-sales: Customer saw session resets and one 502 on the call. They're nervous about reliability.

harper-se: Please paste logs and whether they pinned to a specific pool.

zoe-ps: Logs: 
```
[2026-03-21T09:07:12Z] inference-5: reject id=a1f2c3 code=503 reason="burst_pool_exhausted"
[2026-03-21T09:07:13Z] router: 502 upstream=inference-5 reason="connection_reset"
[2026-03-21T09:07:14Z] autoscaler: pending=20 active=2 target=5 cooldown=50s
[2026-03-21T09:07:20Z] runtime: kv_cache pressure high, long-gen count=3
```

liam-sre: Looks like autoscale cooldown + KV pressure. I will temporarily bump burst_pool and lower cooldown for their org.

ops-bot: CONFIG CHANGE: burst_pool 6->16 for project=greengrocer-poc by liam-sre at 2026-03-21T09:08:05Z

runtime-bot: NOTE: attempted fallback to rwd-small-quant at 09:07:15 but blocked by pool_tag=enterprise-gpu requirement.

liam-sre: Change applied; one final 502 at 09:08:10 then stable. We'll run a replay tomorrow to validate cooldown=12s.

harper-se: For follow-up include short repro, cost note (+~15% for demo window), and config suggestion:
```
project: greengrocer-poc
burst_pool: 16
autoscale:
  cooldown_seconds: 12
limits:
  max_concurrent_generations: 6
fallback:
  allow_cross_pool: true  # opt-in for POCs
```

nina-sales: I'll draft the customer note: "Transient 5xxs occurred during an unexpected burst of long streaming sessions. We increased temporary capacity and tuned autoscaling to recover. For production SLAs we recommend Dedicated or pre-warmed nodes."

zoe-ps: Thanks team, sending follow-up now.
